Furthermore, while the bear highlights the poor multi-year sales record [E13, E14, E15, E56], it dismisses the compelling valuation cushion provided by a price-to-book ratio of 2.75x compared to the much higher sector benchmark of 7.28x [E6]. Finally, the stated market capitalization of ₹ 82.7 Cr [E2] and a modest price-to-book of 1.57x [E1] offer a tangible asset floor that mitigates the current operational distress noted by the bear [E7, E8].

Conceded: the scanX signal engine flags earnings growth accelerating [E61]. However, citing an accelerating earnings signal does not erase a catastrophic return on equity of -99.48% that sits vastly below the sector benchmark of 10.11% [E8]. Similarly, the bull points to a price-to-book ratio of 2.75x against a sector benchmark of 7.28x as a cushion [E6], but this relative discount provides little comfort given that return on assets plummets to -57.46%, lagging far behind the sector benchmark of -40.7% [E7]. The bull's reliance on a tangible asset floor derived from a price-to-book of 1.57x and an ₹ 82.7 Cr market capitalization [E1, E2] ignores the severe ongoing destruction of core business value demonstrated by a staggering 50% collapse in trailing twelve-month sales [E16] and a year-over-year sales decline of 24% [E63].
